note: Golden vectors pinning the canonical AST serializer named by 'serializer'. Every view definition reaches surface_manifest_hash through this serializer, so a change to how a token is spelled would silently move every hash. 'vectors' pin the exact output; 'equivalences' assert that formatting and comments cannot change it; 'distinctions' assert that a semantic difference always does. Regenerate this file only together with a new serializer version.

vectors.name: nested_grouping
vectors.serialization: (w:select ((w:a o:+ w:b) o:* (w:c o:- w:d)) w:from w:t)

vectors.name: operator_maximal_munch

vectors.serialization: (w:select w:a o::: w:text o:, w:j o:->> s:k o:, w:j o:#>> s:{a,b} w:from w:t w:where w:x o:<= n:1 w:and w:y o:<> n:2)

vectors.name: numeric_literals

vectors.name: array_subscript_and_punctuation

vectors.name: half_open_fact_predicate
